in_sanskrit.name: Simpu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Matured, Ripe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Simpu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Simhapura', meaning 'City of Lions'. Simpu symbolizes maturity, ripeness and the beauty of nature. It is a name for a little girl who is expected to grow into a strong and beautiful woman.
